title: Trending Holiday Gifts to Give Your Office Workers
summary: Looking for holiday gifts for office workers? From a noise-cancelling headset and desk organizer to gourmet gift boxes, find corporate gift ideas your team will love.
body_markdown:
When a customer's water heater dies the week before their in-laws visit, or three trucks all report empty at the same intersection, your CSRs and dispatchers are the ones untangling it, often calmly, on the phone, without ever leaving their desk. They keep the whole operation running while your techs get all the credit out in the field.


This year, give them something more thoughtful than a mug from the supply closet. Whether you're shopping for holiday gifts for employees one at a time or coordinating corporate holiday gifts for the whole team, we rounded up ideas your office team will actually want at their desk, from a headset that makes back-to-back calls easier on the ears to the tech gifts, desk accessories, and gourmet treats that make an eight-hour shift feel a little shorter.

## Noise-Cancelling Headset


Give the gift of clearer calls with the[Jabra Evolve2 65 Flex Headset](https://www.amazon.com/Jabra-Evolve2-Bluetooth-Wireless-Charging/dp/B0C1DF5D9R) . It features hybrid active noise cancellation and ClearVoice mic technology, so customers come through clearly even when the office gets busy, plus up to 37 hours of battery life between charges and a wireless charging pad to match.


## AI Wearable Note-Taker


This is where AI meets the front desk. The[Plaud NotePin](https://www.amazon.com/PLAUD-Notetaker-Transcribe-Summarize-Languages/dp/B0DL9WQ4Z4) is a wearable recorder that clips on or wears like a bracelet, letting a CSR capture a quick verbal note between calls instead of scrambling for a sticky pad. Its companion app transcribes and summarizes recordings in seconds, so a rambling voice memo turns into clean notes they can reference later — a handy personal assistant that's separate from whatever's happening on the dispatch board.


## Standing Desk Converter


Help them move more during a long shift with the[FLEXISPOT Standing Desk Converter](https://www.amazon.com/FLEXISPOT-Standing-Converter-Adjustable-Workstation/dp/B0C8TMNWP8) . It sits on top of their existing desk and adjusts from sitting to standing height in seconds, with a spacious two-tier top for a monitor, keyboard, and phone.


## Desk Organizer


Help them tame the sticky notes, pens, and loose office supplies piling up by the keyboard. The[Amazon Basics Mesh Desk Organizer](https://www.amazon.com/Amazon-Basics-Mesh-Office-Organizer/dp/B08VPFB5G3) combines a pen holder, a pullout drawer, and an office caddy in one compact footprint — one of those desk organizers that earns its spot the day it arrives.


## Insulated Water Bottle


The[Owala FreeSip Water Bottle](https://www.amazon.com/Owala-Insulated-Stainless-Steel-Push-Button-24-Ounce/dp/B085DTZQNZ) is a favorite piece of drinkware for a reason. Its two-way spout switches between a straw and a push-button opening, and double-wall insulation keeps drinks cold through a full shift at the desk.


## Power Bank


For the commute home or a phone that never quite makes it to 100%, a[Belkin BoostCharge 10,000mAh Power Bank](https://www.amazon.com/Belkin-BoostCharge-Portable-Charger-Samsung/dp/B0CV9FXV8Z) delivers fast charging from three ports at once, so they're never stuck watching a battery icon turn red during a long shift.


## Reusable Smart Notebook


For the CSR who still likes writing things down, the[Rocketbook Core Reusable Smart Notebook](https://www.amazon.com/Rocketbook-Reusable-Spiral-Notebook-Letter/dp/B071Y3MSRK) looks and feels like a regular notebook, but each page can be scanned to the cloud with a companion app, then wiped clean with a damp cloth and reused. It's a handy way to jot down a callback number mid-shift without a drawer full of old notepads.


## Umbrella


Keep them dry on the walk to the car after a closing shift. The[totes Titan Portable Travel Umbrella](https://www.amazon.com/totes-Titan-Windproof-Water-Resistant-Umbrella/dp/B09SRT7136/ref=sr_1_1?crid=PZ3ET4A8KGL3&dib=eyJ2IjoiMSJ9.K30GBjYQYdH62F_39ixsCiXRvLp5kabwIZ3GHjkJUxyLiRzBhyKXn2QYj0WmqGE-ub9rAX6Me3JLqnPxmiydOMYzcILs201PtEMj8TbdReDIVCtF5evJFmTXEJ9-XdixnYL5rgT8ls52CXhWu3kQ8FvmCD5Tl81E2NnWcC_pimFeQv7XaTb9a2V5P7qaoOiyN6YOaUxzacbL8LhbEvgKwc_UxleS3xeeWuEDPaC6et_-GiOLHYe7p_V8WFP2ZGWvU-lIqWgCGkyL9WDUsXsIxEE2eAjzhhwAYyc8mgtXKUc.4ww8ckFCZI7Y14S9xdUbAmWAj9uk1L1wlth4J-Tocuo&dib_tag=se&keywords=titan+travel+umbrella&qid=1790615084&sprefix=titan+travel+umbrella%2Caps%2C114&sr=8-1) is windproof, water-resistant, and compact enough to keep in a desk drawer or bag — and branded umbrellas are an easy one to order in bulk with a company logo for the whole office.


## Custom Logo Apparel


For a gift the whole team can wear to the holiday party (or the next casual Friday),[custom logo quarter-zips and outerwear](https://www.4imprint.com/tag/387/quarter-zips) turn everyday apparel into a piece of company swag. It's a popular pick for corporate Christmas gifts and bulk Christmas gifts alike, since most promotional suppliers offer volume pricing the more you order.


## Gourmet Gift Box


Can't decide on one thing? Gift baskets and gourmet snack boxes cover a lot of ground at once. The[Harry & David Deluxe Sweet and Salty Gift Box](https://www.amazon.com/Harry-Davids-Deluxe-Sweet-Salty/dp/B0BY3P2WYC) packs cookie gifts, kettle corn, and other gourmet food into one holiday gift box that's built for sharing around the office — one of the easier Christmas gifts for coworkers who split a breakroom, with no assembly, wrapping, or guessing required.


## Stocking Stuffers


If you need last-minute employee Christmas gifts or are looking for a little something extra, consider these no-fail options:


-


A holiday bonus or extra paid time off.


-


Visa gift cards, or egift cards to local restaurants or stores.


-


Hand warmers for cold weather days.


-


A gift for a Secret Santa or white elephant gift exchange.
